payload.name: Image caching & optimization
payload.description: Replace all raw `Image.network()` calls with a proper caching layer using `cached_network_image` + a dedicated image cache service, with error handling that never shows exceptions to users.

goal.answer: Replace all raw `Image.network()` calls with a proper caching layer using `cached_network_image` + a dedicated image cache service, with error handling that never shows exceptions to users.

payload.plain: Replace all raw `Image.network()` calls with a proper caching layer using `cached_network_image` + a dedicated image cache service, with error handling that never shows exceptions to users.

criteria.answer:
All Image.network() calls replaced with CachedNetworkImageWrapper
No error messages or exceptions visible to end users
Preloaded images show immediately without network delay
App compiles and runs without regressions

plain: All Image.network() calls replaced with CachedNetworkImageWrapper

constraints.answer: Must not break any existing functionality, Must use existing cached_network_image dependency (already in pubspec), Must handle all error states gracefully (network failure, invalid URL, empty URL)

plain: Must not break any existing functionality

phases.answer: Phase 1: Install & create cache service, Phase 2: Replace all Image.network() calls, Phase 3: Preload & optimize

phaseSnapshots.name: Phase 1: Install & create cache service
phaseSnapshots.goal: Add dependency, create ImageCacheService, and set up a global image cache provider
phaseSnapshots.description: Install cached_network_image package, create a dedicated ImageCacheService class, and build a provider-level image cache that all network images will use.

steps.description: Add cached_network_image to pubspec.yaml and run flutter pub get
Create lib/services/image_cache_service.dart - a dedicated cache service with preload, memory/disk tiers, and error swallowing

Create lib/widgets/cached_network_image_wrapper.dart - a drop-in replacement widget that wraps CachedNetworkImage with errorBuilder that silently falls back to a placeholder icon, never showing exceptions to users
Register the image cache service as a provider in the app's provider setup

phaseSnapshots.name: Phase 2: Replace all Image.network() calls
phaseSnapshots.goal: Replace every raw Image.network() call across the codebase with the cached wrapper
phaseSnapshots.description: Find every occurrence of Image.network() in the lib directory and replace it with the new CachedNetworkImageWrapper, ensuring users never see broken-image errors or loading failures.

steps.description: Find and replace Image.network() calls in screens/kaascan_ai.dart - the main AI screen
Find and replace Image.network() calls in components/chat_bubble.dart - the chat bubble component
Find and replace Image.network() calls in components/addStudent.dart
Find and replace Image.network() calls in components/typing_indicator.dart
Find and replace Image.network() calls in dashboard/students.dart
Find and replace Image.network() calls in dashboard/home.dart

phaseSnapshots.name: Phase 3: Preload & optimize
phaseSnapshots.goal: Add proactive image preloading for common screens and optimize response caching
phaseSnapshots.description: Add preloadImage() calls at strategic points in the app lifecycle and on app start, so images are cached before users see them, and add a fallback/placeholder strategy.

steps.description: Add preloading in splash.dart and main.dart - preload common images (logos, avatars) on app init
Add preloading for student photos when the student list loads (in chat_bubble.dart's initState)
Verify all cached images work with loading/error/placeholder states and no exceptions leak to users

assumptions.answer: cached_network_image is already in pubspec.yaml so just needs import; All image URLs are remote HTTPS URLs; The app already has a provider-based state management pattern

decision.title: Created wrapper infrastructure first
decision.description: Phase 1 creates the 3 infrastructure files (wrapper widget, cache service, provider) before touching any existing Image.network() calls. Phase 2 then replaces all calls.

decision.title: Paused — user wants to apply changes manually
decision.description: The user has the complete solution plan. They'll apply the 3 new files and replace all Image.network() calls themselves.
